quoted_tweet.author: Brian Roemmele
quoted_tweet.text:
Once You Really Grok Bot, You Never Go Back To Non-Grok Bot

Once you use Grok Bot enough, it is very difficult to go back to an old chat window with an AI that can’t get things done. It is a brain with no virtual hands.

The symbiosis you develop with Bot is quite profound as it remembers long term goals in a much more complex way to actually not only get answers but to actually get the work done you needed the answer for.

In almost all cases Bot understands what you are doing and doesn’t just tell you how to do it. Bot offers to do all the steps to get the work done.

But that isn’t the entire magic, understanding your goals enough Bot will expand what you are doing to levels you have not thought of and possess the abilities to get it all done.

We thought the computer era started with the mainframe computer at one time. But it really started when anyone had that super computer in their pocket.

Grok Bot is that same step change, you get Super Intelligence in your pocket so useful, the very device, OS and apps you once used matters no more…

It’s just you Grok Bot and the work you toiled over getting done by one of the best employees you will ever hire.

It’s that simple.
